sloka: तच्च सर्वम् महाबाहो शक्यम् वोढुम् जितेइन्द्रियैः ।तव वश्य इन्द्रियत्वम् च जानामि शुभदर्शन ॥३-९-८॥
transliteration: tacca sarvam mahābāho śakyam voḍhum jiteindriyaiḥ ।tava vaśya indriyatvam ca jānāmi śubhadarśana ॥3-9-8॥

translations.english: O longarmed one, to contain all this is only possible for those who have conquered the senses. O handsome one, I know your ability to control the senses.
